title: Geometric transformation theorem, fundamental groups and monotone of numbers of almost Euclidean factors of geodesic balls
summary: In \cite{HH}, H. Huang-X.Huang introduced the generalized Reifenberg condition which describes the non-increasing property of numbers of almost Euclidean factors of geodesic balls and gave a transformation theorem under this condition. In this note, we will prove a transformation theorem under a non-decreasing property compared with the non-increasing property above and give an example that transformation theorem is false without the monotone property.
